title: [29.x][ALL-E] Posting a Sales Credit Memo with a different Unit of Measure does not convert the quantity before updating the originating Sales Order (Blanket Sales Order is updated correctly)
summary: Posting a sales credit memo with a different unit of measure now correctly converts the quantity before updating the originating sales order, preventing incorrect deductions from shipped and invoiced quantities.
key_points: Credit memo quantities are converted to the sales order line's unit of measure before updating order quantities
Fixes incorrect quantity deductions when units differ (e.g., 8 PCS no longer incorrectly treated as 8 SET)
Solution applies the sales order line's conversion factor to the credited base quantity
Regression tests added for different, fractional, and matching unit scenarios
quote: Convert the credited base quantity using the sales order line's Qty. per Unit of Measure before updating quantities.
